registryBasis: ANCFCC lists cadastral offices in Marrakech Gueliz and Marrakech Menara, alongside local land-conservation offices. Its cartography page describes a simplified public urban plan for Marrakech, but not a parcel vector layer. The online cadastral-plan request is applicant/title-specific and includes identity/address, title number, captcha, phone/SMS and payment fields; it was inspected only as a form and not submitted.

officialSources.observation: Official ANCFCC network page lists cadastral services in Marrakech Gueliz and Menara.
ANCFCC describes a generalized simplified public urban plan and shows a Marrakech excerpt at 1:15,000; it is not parcel-vector evidence.
Public cadastral-plan request form exposes applicant identity/address, land-title number, CAPTCHA, mobile/SMS verification, and payment fields. Form not submitted; no title or applicant values used.
Official Arabic product page lists generalized city/topographic cartographic products and local Marrakech cadastral-service contact; no open parcel layer advertised.
ANCFCC explains its statutory cadastral and land-conservation tasks, including maintaining cadastral documents and digitized updated cadastral information.
